Name: Squishy Marsh(Custom Farm)
Author: kittnet
Description:
[center][u]features:[/u]
- does not replace vanilla farms; choose from additional farms menu
- i18n support﻿(currently only in english, but support is there... i didn't want to add low quality machine translation...)
- optional farm cave
- tillable grass tiles
- fishys(including minnow, tadpoles and frogs if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]stardew valley expanded[/url]﻿)
- 4 player multiplayer

[u]config:[/u]
- additional starting gift: none, crabpot, fish smoker
- worldmap: as the custom one will clash with map recolours, you can disable it if you please
- enable cave: whether or not you would like to use the custom cave

[u]recommended:[/u]
any mod that allows you to plant things anywhere(such as [url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere/releases]anything anywhere(unofficial update)[/url]﻿). ...just in case i missed a few tiles, making them tillable...

mods in pictures:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]vibrant pastoral[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]simple foliage[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15026]simple resources[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]better water[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]visible fish[/url]﻿

make sure you download the requirements first.
thank you for playing ![/center]
